evidence_slice: Rushcliffe Borough Council's Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment Report 2025 uses an identified-supply position at 31 March 2025. Table 3, Housing Delivery Site by Site 6 to 10 years, lists site reference SHLAA/BUN/001, parish Bunny, site name Bunny Brickworks, with 44 dwellings in the 6-10 year period. The council's Bunny Housing Land Assessment records the same site reference and name, 2.4 hectares, brownfield status, dwelling capacity 110, allocated site reference Policy 23, extant outline planning permission, planning reference 21/02109/OUT, and 110 dwellings remaining.
